shots.alt: Shapr in dark mode with the baseline purple seed: demo spaces with two worktrees and six agents in the sidebar, an agent session in the centre, the Files panel open on the right
The same window in light mode with the same purple seed: a lavender frame around white cards
The Shapr Theme dialog with the pink seed: mode, eight seed colours, contrast, density, corners and motion

notes: Shots come from the shot loop (bin/shot-window, bin/demo with SHAPR_DEMO=/tmp/shapr-demo, bin/shots) and are masked: only the demo spaces and their fake agents show. bin/demo shows Shapr after its agents settle, so no shot has a snackbar.
